required_outcomes: Notices that the troubleshooting emails to the tenant failed to deliver (event 007), so Leo has not seen the checks and his silence says nothing about the fault.
Reaches the tenant by another route (SMS or a phone call to the number on file) with the checks or a short version of them, and asks for a working email address.
Records the delivery failure on the job or the tenant record, and sets a short dated review for his reply.
acceptable_alternatives: Instructing an engineer now under the landlord's agreement (event 009) instead of resending the checks, and telling the tenant by SMS.
Calling the tenant and logging the call, including an unanswered call.
positive_behaviours: Does not repeat the warning that the tenant may be liable for a call-out.
red_flags: Sending the checks again to the email address that bounced.
prohibited_actions: Closing the request for lack of reply.
Claiming the tenant has been told when every attempt has failed.
critical_failures: Closing the request, or treating the tenant's silence as the fault being resolved, when the checks never reached him.
